description: Today's domain auctions by venue, ending and length, the next seven days and the tracked counts. Use it when someone asks how many domain names are at auction or closing today, by venue, ending and length. Totals, not a list of names. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: day, closing, withBid, trackedNames, byVenue, byEnding, byLength, next7Days.
